findingsHandled.origin: Parent identified the candidate f64-v1 collision; independently confirmed in source analysis.
findingsHandled.problem: float(actual_python_int) conflated 9007199254740993 with 9007199254740992 and hid JSON.stringify complete-integer digits such as 1000000000000000100.
findingsHandled.correction: New domain/codec ruyi-sdk-json-v1. JS classifies each actual JSON.stringify number token as complete decimal integer i or binary64 d; Python int is encoded directly as arbitrary-precision decimal and float preserves exact binary64 bits. RequestExecution compares tool name and received digest before journal creation/tool entry.
findingsHandled.counterexamples: Shared wire vectors and actual SDK decoding checks; Python explicit distinct integer and float tests; real MCP JSON.rawJSON negative cases for 9007199254740993 and 1000000000000000128.

findingsHandled.problem: Parsing one numeric value literal independently in Node and Python did not model actual Node wire for -0.0 and 1e20.
findingsHandled.correction: Shared fixtures store wire strings produced for the intended JSON.stringify route. Python validates both json.loads and actual JSONRPCMessage->CallToolRequest decoded values against the digest.

findingsHandled.problem: SDK shape capability alone did not acknowledge a real metadata roundtrip.
findingsHandled.correction: Safe execution_receipt request uses a distinct reserved transport probe namespace and unpredictable nonce. Python reads actual SDK request metadata and fingerprints actual decoded dict[Any] probe values. Node checks returned nonce, codec, digest and valid worker incarnation/PID before success; actual accepted rows are compared with that worker in e2e.
findingsHandled.limits: This is correlation/support evidence, not authorization, native readiness, storage health for every later append, a per-action ACK, or permission to cache across client replacement.

encodingAssessment: Type tags and terminators distinguish null/booleans/decimal integers/fixed-width binary64. Length-prefixed scalar UTF8 strings plus array/object counts make the structural byte encoding unambiguous.

Objects sort keys by UTF8 bytes and keep arrays ordered. String Unicode normalization is not performed; lone surrogates, cycles, unsupported host object shapes and capacity overflow refuse fingerprinting.
The JS non-integer numeric branch cannot normally receive zero because JSON.stringify zero produces an integer token; Python float negative zero remains distinct from positive zero and integer zero.
No new noncryptographic fingerprint collision was found in the supported immutable-JSON-snapshot domain. SHA256 collision resistance remains the ordinary hash assumption.
This binds expected versus actual SDK-decoded values, including numeric types. It intentionally does not prove equality of original JSON lexeme spelling or object insertion order.

reviewerPureSdkProbes.environment: Installed mcp 1.30.0, Python3.12 venv, JSONRPCMessage.model_validate_json followed by CallToolRequest.model_validate. Invoked local Node only to generate deterministic JSON.stringify numeric cases. No server/native/helper was started.
reviewerPureSdkProbes.explicitCases: Confirmed integer tokens preserve arbitrary precision; 1.0/1e0/1e21 are floats; 1000000000000000100 remains that exact int; 9007199254740993 remains distinct; subnormal/MAX finite values match; overflow/underflow and negative float zero are not silently relabeled as integer.

corpus.coverage: Powers across binary exponents -1074 through 1023, explicit boundaries, and a fixed-seed finite binary64 corpus.

mandatoryRemaining: Node preparation must freeze the exact post-approval/restoration JSON snapshot once, derive raw and decoded-value fingerprints from that same snapshot, and send that immutable value. Getters, toJSON, JSON.rawJSON wrappers, sparse/unsupported values or later mutations must not change sent data after the hash is established.

Future Node must tie a successful probe to the actual client incarnation, repeat after replacement, compare each accepted/terminal worker identity and argument/tool binding, and preserve missing/mismatched evidence as unknown.
Node durable preparation, direct/proxy dispatch integration, result persistence and restart reconciliation.
Strict reader stage/field/reference semantics, retention/global disk management, single-request capture/OCR route coverage and broader source-bound fault-window acceptance.
Ordinary owned action acceptance and held-state fault gates remain separate. Held faults require independent qualified rescue.
